notes.title: Magus Pocus v1.1.0 update is available. Only $4.99 for the full game
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GHd0ytVzhhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
When we launched Magus Pocus we already had in mind that it wouldn't be the final version. From the beginning, we decided to make updates to the game. Improved graphics, new levels, addition of new mechanics, all to bring maximum fun to players. That's why we worked on the first update, FREE. That's right, it's ready and you can upgrade your Magus Pocus game without spending an extra penny.

Adjusted the parallax effect to give it more depth. And yet in this context we also added images closer to the camera giving a feeling of immersion. Modified minor mechanics of some traps. With this, we want to provide our players with a pleasant experience and make them feel part of the game.
Some of the modifications.
- Improved parallax effect.
- Enrichment of scenarios.
- Mechanical modification of some traps.
- Added another Steam achievement.
